props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the markdown after every edit.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the text area. Pair with a Field for a visible label.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the text area is empty.

props.name: rows
props.description: Visible lines in the text area.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The HTML level a `#` heading renders at in the preview, so it fits the page’s outline.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as failing validation.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

props.name: id
props.description: Goes on the text area, so a Field label points at it.
